findings.message: The alternative reading for vilocanāya is glossed '(to Him) with (striking) eyes' (hi: 'जिनके नेत्र विलक्षण हैं'), and words.w2.notes.hi calls it 'सुन्दर नेत्रों वाले को'. mw-vilocana.md gives only 'the eye, sight' or 'distorting the eyes'. No evidence file supports 'striking' or 'beautiful', and the two Hindi glosses disagree with each other. This is a recorded alternative with medium confidence, so it is not a fail. A human should decide whether to drop the qualifier.
findings.suggested_fix: Gloss the alternative as '(to Him) with eyes, the seeing one', and use the same Hindi wording in notes.hi and alternatives.reading.hi.
